description: Engine setup of map6_s02 (Lakeside Pier and Lighthouse), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type RSU, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Alessa). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: light_glow (glowing light sprites) and lake_surface (the lake surface, drawn while bit 5 of the map variable map_effect_flags is set). Here lake_surface is the lake of the UFO ending. A mod changes it with its own maps/map6_s02/overlay.json.
